clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Anastasia Hartwell gives apprentices a scroll to reveal unseen magical beings in Algernon's shop.

The Cantation of Manifestation reveals beings hidden by magic. Anastasia Hartwell keeps the scroll in the Magic Quarter and entrusts it to capable mages sent to contain rogue magical anomalies. Read aloud where arcane instability troubles the air, such as Algernon's alchemical workshop in the Apothecarium, its words force stray rift spawns into sight. The caster can then subdue them and trap them in containment coffers for further study.
